profile_id.description: Account row that refused this model before generation started.

account_fingerprint.description: Provider account identity the mark is bound to; null when the adapter has none.

provider_reason.description: Latest refusal diagnostic, redacted and at most 1024 characters: the provider's reason for a recognized refusal, the engine's message and vendor code otherwise.

observed_at.description: Start of this mark's episode, when its row was created (a recognized refusal, or the service elsewhere that confirmed an unrecognized one); renewals and probes keep it.

expires_at.description: Probe becomes eligible at this time; not a vendor reset.

state.description: provisional = refused here; confirmed = another account then served the correlated retry; probe_due = expired, the next selection may probe it; probing = one operation holds that probe.

items.description: A temporary capability mark for one account and one model. It only orders auto selection: the account stays enabled and usable as a last fallback.

capabilities.description: Temporary capability marks; absent from engines that predate them. A mark clears on a success there or a catalog or credential change; after expires_at one operation may probe the account.

profile_id.description: Registered account row the refusal was observed on.

model.description: Model the refused run requested, exactly as requested; a vendor-reported id that differs from it does not clear the observation.

code.description: Typed reason an observed credential is unusable: vendor rejection, entitlement refusal, or a failed profile verification probe.

detail.description: Redacted typed evidence of the refusal, such as the vendor's error category; null when none was observed.

expires_at.description: Self-expiry of the observation (bounded retention, not a vendor reset time).

items.description: A live typed refusal of one model on one registered account. It affects routing for that model only and never changes the account's status, Enabled state or order.

credentialUnusable.description: Live model-scoped credential refusals of the registered rows, most recent first per account, present only when the client asked (includeCredentialUnusable=true). One clears on a later service of exactly that model, a credential change, or expiry.

harness_id.description: Harness family the observed account belongs to.

profile_id.description: Account row whose started session was refused before progress.

requested_model.description: Model the run asked this account for; null = the harness default model.

observed_at.description: When the pre-progress refusal was observed.

expires_at.description: Self-expiry instant (observation retention, not a vendor reset time); after this the observation is ignored.

items.description: A bounded, self-expiring typed observation that an account refused a started session before any progress; it orders the account pool and never excludes a row.

refusals.description: Live pre-progress refusal observations, each scoped to one requested model.

profile_id.description: Account row that served the request.

requested_model.description: Model the run asked for; null = the harness default model.

observed_at.description: When the account was observed serving that request.

items.description: The latest observed service of one account for one requested model under its current credential binding.

lastService.description: Latest observed service per registered account and requested model, most recent service first.

ControlAccountRoutingEvidenceResponse.description: Model-scoped account routing evidence: live refusal marks, temporary capability marks, model-scoped credential refusals and the durable last-served order.
